text: Source: UNESCO — Guidance for Generative AI in Education and Research Published: 2023 Official URL: https://www.unesco.org/en/articles/guidance-generative-ai-education-and-research UNESCO published guidance in 2023 to help governments, educational institutions, teachers, and researchers understand the opportunities and risks of generative artificial intelligence in education. The guidance explains that generative AI may support teaching, learning, curriculum design, and research.

explains that generative AI may support teaching, learning, curriculum design, and research. However, AI should not be treated as a complete solution to the challenges facing education systems. UNESCO emphasizes a human-centred approach to AI. Educational technology should support human agency, inclusion, equity, and cultural and linguistic diversity. Teachers and learners should retain meaningful control over educational decisions.

Teachers and learners should retain meaningful control over educational decisions. The guidance identifies concerns involving privacy, safety, copyright, and potentially harmful or misleading outputs. It recommends appropriate policies, safeguards, and training so educational institutions can evaluate AI tools before adopting them. Teachers and researchers need support to use generative AI effectively and responsibly.

Teachers and researchers need support to use generative AI effectively and responsibly. Institutions should consider whether a tool is pedagogically appropriate, ethically acceptable, and suitable for the learners who will use it. The guidance also highlights protecting personal data and considering age-appropriate use. AI tools should be used thoughtfully, with human judgement and responsible governance.
